description: Free-text search across the whole site: projects, developer pages, area guides, informational guide pages and blog articles. Use this for any question the project tools do not answer directly (buying process, freehold ownership, visas, mortgages, fees, market news) and cite the pages it returns.

lang.description: Language of the answer. Default en.

limit.description: Max results per group, default 5, hard cap 20

query.description: Search text, e.g. "buying process for foreigners", "freehold ownership", "Wynn casino"

types.description: Optional subset of result groups. Default: all five.

name: search_site
title: Search the site
